proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Before Steve Rogers takes the Infinity Stones back to their own times, Bucky Barnes says goodbye to him, knowing his best friend will not come back. Steve stays in the past to live out his life.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Bucky's best friend since Brooklyn. Says goodbye before staying in the past.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Steve's best friend, who sees him off before he stays in the past.

changes.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: after Tony's funeral Bucky sees Steve off at the time machine ("Gonna miss you, buddy." / "It's gonna be okay, Buck."); Steve stays in the past and returns old. Their last on-screen scene together, a farewell with no stage after Civil War.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Clint loses Laura to the Snap on the family farm and is reunited with her five years later, when she calls him after the Blip.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's wife, lost to the Snap and found again five years later.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Laura's husband, who loses her to the Snap and gets her back five years later.

changes.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: Laura and the children vanish in the Snap during the farm picnic in front of Clint; after the Blip she phones him ("Honey." / "Clint?") and the family is reunited. Matches the Endgame stages already on Clint|Cooper and Clint|Lila.

proposed.title: Avengers: Endgame
proposed.text: Clint loses Nathaniel to the Snap and is reunited with him five years later.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Clint's youngest son, lost to the Snap and found again five years later.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Nathaniel's dad, who loses him to the Snap and gets him back five years later.

changes.evidence: Avengers: Endgame: Nathaniel plays catch on the farm and vanishes with Laura, Cooper and Lila in the Snap while Clint is there; the family is reunited after the Blip. Matches the Endgame stages already on Clint|Cooper and Clint|Lila.
